description: Search the user's own notes and captures by meaning and keyword. Returns up to 10 matching excerpts with note ids, titles and dates, ranked by relevance. Does NOT list notes by title or date (use find_notes) and does NOT return a full note body (use read_note with the id).

query.description: The search query — a topic, theme, question, or keyword.

scripture_refs.description: Canonical scripture references to search for (e.g. ['ROM.8.28', 'JHN.3.16']). Optional.

name: search_notes
title: Search notes
